titre: Exportations américaines de liquides de gaz naturel
sous_titre: Milliers de barils par jour, moyenne de l'année 2025

Propane.texte: U.S. propane exports averaged a record 1.8 million barrels per day (b/d) in 2025, the most since we began collecting this data in 1973.

Éthane.texte: In 2025, the United States exported a total of 579,000 b/d of ethane to nine countries.

Butane normal.texte: U.S. normal butane exports have increased every year since 2006, reaching a record-high average of nearly 535,000 b/d in 2025.

Essence naturelle.texte: Although natural gasoline exports rose to 176,000 b/d (22%) in 2025, exports have been relatively stable.
